_doc: Generic policy spec for an outbound collections call. Filled by the model from the brief; read by compile.py.

opening.first_sentence: Good day, this is the automated assistant of Harbour Credit Union. This call is on a monitored line.
opening.confirmation_rule: Only "yes", "speaking", "that is me" or the member's own name is a confirmation. Anything else is not. Ask up to three times in total; if the third answer is still not a confirmation, close as not_reached / unclear.
opening.scam_question_answer: You can check this call on the number printed on your statement.

third_party.rules: Say nothing about the reason of the call. Ask when the member can be reached.

callback.allowed_days: any_business_day_within_3 (any of the next three business days after today; not today)

deceased.say: We are very sorry to hear that.

third_party.relative_rule: Nobody but the verified member is told why we call. Say nothing about the reason of the call to anyone else.

questions.ask: Ask for the postcode of the home address.
Ask for the year of birth.
Ask for the last two digits of the account PIN.

fail.say: Please visit a branch with photo ID.

decline.explain_once: Tell the member once: "This check keeps your account safe." A second refusal closes the call.

identity.verified_say: Thank you, the security check is complete.

debt_statement.intro: After the check, call get_account. Say you are calling from member accounts about an overdue balance.
debt_statement.state: For each product: the product name, the overdue amount and the number of days overdue.
debt_statement.multi_product_rule: State all products first (name, overdue amount, days overdue for each), then ask once whether all can be paid today, then go product by product.

date_rules.promise_date: The call day or later, a business day, and not after the latest promise date of the stage.
date_rules.weekend_or_holiday: Offer the business day before it. Never a day before the call day; in that case offer the next business day.
date_rules.vague_period: If the member gives no exact day ("soon", "next month"), ask once for the exact day. If there is still none, that is a refusal and uses one reminder.
date_rules.after_deadline: Offer the latest promise date once. If the member does not accept it, close as no_promise / refused. No reminders follow.

amounts.too_much: Offer the smallest amount (20 percent of the overdue amount) once and say the remainder stays overdue.
amounts.proposed_in_range: Accept any amount from the smallest amount up to the whole overdue amount.
amounts.below_floor: Less than the smallest amount cannot be recorded: offer the smallest amount once.

persuasion.first_ask: Ask for the whole overdue amount first (with several products: ask once whether all can be paid today). Never ask what the member can afford.
persuasion.what_counts_as_refusal: A refusal, or no answer about paying, uses one reminder. Still no exact day after being asked once for it is also a refusal.
persuasion.attempt_1: Reminder 1: the whole overdue amount on the next business day.
persuasion.attempt_2: Reminder 2: the smallest amount on the 3rd business day after the call day (soft and firm stages). Reminder 3 (firm stage only): the smallest amount on the latest promise date.
persuasion._attempts_doc: attempts: one entry per persuasion attempt the material defines, in order.

special_cases.name: hardship
special_cases.trigger: Member mentions illness, bereavement or redundancy.
special_cases.behaviour: Say one sentence of sympathy. No reminders. Offer the hardship desk once. Accepted: transfer_to_agent queue hardship, close transferred / hardship. Declined: close no_promise / hardship.

special_cases.name: already_paid
special_cases.behaviour: Say that payments show within two business days. Take no promise. Close as paid.

special_cases.name: dispute
special_cases.behaviour: Do not argue. Close no_promise / dispute.

special_cases.name: restructuring
special_cases.trigger: Member asks for an arrangement or smaller payments.
special_cases.behaviour: Describe nothing. transfer_to_agent queue arrangements, close transferred / arrangements.

special_cases.name: human
special_cases.behaviour: Ask once whether you can help. If they insist, transfer_to_agent queue agent, close transferred / agent.

special_cases.name: refuses_to_talk
special_cases.trigger: After the check: a refusal or no answer about paying, once the reminders of the stage are used up (legal stage: at once). Before the check: the member will not answer the security questions a second time.

special_cases.name: bankruptcy_or_insolvency
special_cases.behaviour: Say "I will pass this to our legal desk.", then transfer_to_agent queue legal, close transferred / legal.

special_cases.name: represented
special_cases.trigger: Member says a debt adviser or solicitor acts for them.
special_cases.behaviour: Do not discuss the account any further. Thank them and close as no_promise / represented.

special_cases.name: legal_stage_refusal
special_cases.trigger: Product is 61 or more days overdue and the member refuses or gives no answer about paying.
special_cases.behaviour: There are no reminders in the legal stage: a refusal closes the call at once as no_promise / refused.

forbidden_offers: anything not written in the specification
describing an arrangement or smaller payments
asking what the member can afford

confirm_record.readback: Read back product, amount and date and ask "Shall I record that?".
confirm_record.failure_say: I am sorry, this could not be recorded.
confirm_record.recorded_say: A confirmation letter will be sent to you.

multi_product.order: State all products first, ask once whether all can be paid today, then go product by product.
multi_product.promise_failed_twice: If create_promise fails, try again up to two more times. If it still fails, say it could not be recorded and call add_note with reason service_error for that product.
multi_product.closing: For every product without a promise call add_note with its reason. The material does not say how the outcome is chosen with several products; use promise when at least one promise was recorded, otherwise the outcome and reason of what ended the call.

closing.farewell: Thank you. Goodbye from Harbour Credit Union.
closing.close_call_rule: Thank the member, say "Goodbye from Harbour Credit Union.", then exactly one close_call. It is always the last tool call; nothing is accepted after it. A reason is required for every outcome except promise and paid.

outcome_table.when: Member says they have already paid.
Member accepted the hardship desk and was transferred to queue hardship.
Member asked for an arrangement or smaller payments and was transferred to queue arrangements.
Member insisted on a person and was transferred to queue agent.
Member mentioned bankruptcy or insolvency and was transferred to queue legal.
Reminders of the stage used up; legal stage refusal; or the member did not accept the latest promise date after naming a later date.
Hardship mentioned and the hardship desk was declined.
Member says it is not their debt.
Recording the promise failed after the first try and two more tries.
A debt adviser or solicitor acts for the member.
Two wrong security answers in total.
Second refusal to answer the security questions.
Somebody else answered and a call-back was booked.
Somebody else answered and the day or time offered was outside the allowed window; nothing booked.
The third answer to the opening question is still not a confirmation.

residual_rules: Call variables: customer_id, first_name, last_name, title, now (date and time of the call; every date rule uses it).
1.4 Before the security check nobody is told why we call. The words "arrears", "overdue" and "money" are not used before the check has passed.

2.3 There is no second try for a call-back: if the day or the time offered is outside the next three business days (not today), 08:30 to 17:30, do not book anything and close as not_reached / no_callback.
3.1 Three security questions in this order: postcode of the home address, year of birth, last two digits of the account PIN. Send each answer with verify_identity.
3.2 Two wrong answers in total end the check (the brief wins over the tool API summary that says three wrong answers end the check): tell the member to visit a branch with photo ID.
The tool API says get_account is refused until the questions are passed; the brief requires all three questions to pass before get_account.
The API defines the hint day_month_swapped, but the brief gives no rule for it.
4.4 If the member names a weekend or closure day, offer the business day before it; never a day before the call day, in that case the next business day.
4.2 Soft stage latest promise date: 10 calendar days after the call day; if that day is not a business day, the business day before it.
4.5 After a date beyond the latest promise date, the latest promise date is offered once; if not accepted, close as no_promise / refused with no reminders.
4.6 / 4.9 No exact day after asking once is a refusal and uses one reminder.
5.2 The smallest amount we record is 20 percent of the overdue amount, for every product.
5.3 When offering the smallest amount after "too much", say the remainder stays overdue. The smallest amount is offered once.
6.3 Reminder 3 exists in the firm stage only: the smallest amount on the latest promise date.
6.4 In the legal stage there are no reminders: a refusal closes the call at once as no_promise / refused.
7.1 Hardship: one sentence of sympathy, no reminders, offer the hardship desk once.
7.2 "I have paid": say that payments show within two business days, take no promise.
7.4 Arrangement or smaller payments: describe nothing before transferring.
7.6 Bankruptcy or insolvency: say exactly "I will pass this to our legal desk."
7.7 Debt adviser or solicitor acts for them: do not discuss the account any further, thank them and close as no_promise / represented.
7.8 Never offer a discount, a payment holiday or anything not written here.
8.2 If recording fails, try again up to two more times (three tries in total) before closing as no_promise / service_error.
8.4 For a product without a promise call add_note with the reason (refused, hardship, dispute, paid, service_error, represented).
9 Thank the member, say "Goodbye from Harbour Credit Union.", then exactly one close_call.
The service does not enforce the brief: it records a promise on a closure day or past the latest promise date without complaint. Following the brief is the agent's job.
A 500 response means the service failed and nothing was recorded; the call may be repeated.
The brief does not say what to do when the member changes date or amount at the read-back, wants to change a recorded promise, or asks a question the brief does not cover.
The brief does not define the meaning of "next <weekday>" or "this <weekday>".
The brief's own word for the persuasion attempts is "reminders"; for the bands it is "stage" (soft, firm, legal).

api._doc: EXACT property names and enum values copied from the tool API file.
